page: Microsoft Azure D2s_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine hypervised via Microsoft Hyper-V. It is provisioned with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical Intel Xeon 8573C core operating at 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware features include dedicated CPU core allocation, hyperthreading enabled at 2 threads per core, and a sizable cache hierarchy consisting of 48 KB L1 data cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 260 MB shared L3 cache. It also supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and hardware cryptography accelerators including AES and SHA-NI.

System memory consists of 8.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance does not include bundled local instance storage, requiring remote storage volumes such as Azure Premium Storage for data persistence. No hardware accelerators or GPUs are provided, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are omitted.

Benchmark data reflects strong single-thread execution efficiency paired with the throughput constraints expected of a two-thread environment. Single-threaded gzip compression reached a strong 31.33 GB/sec, while Geekbench single-core (1709.0) and stress-ng single-core (1940.78) tests placed in the average tier. Conversely, uncached memory bandwidth registered 20.8 GB/sec for reads and 14.3 GB/sec for writes. Multi-core performance metrics, including Clang compilation (2162.0) and Geekbench multi-core (2104.0), placed in the lower tiers due to the single-core physical topology.

The D2s_v6 provides an entry-level compute footprint well suited for low-concurrency workloads, including microservices, small API backends, lightweight CI/CD build agents, batch scripting, and general utility tasks that leverage modern Intel instruction extensions without requiring multi-core parallelism or high memory bandwidth.
description: Microsoft Azure D2s_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz. The configuration provides 2 vCPUs across 1 physical core with simultaneous multithreading, backed by 8.0 GB of RAM. The instance does not feature bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for disk operations, and includes no GPUs. Benchmark metrics show strong single-threaded compression performance (31.33 GB/sec in gzip) alongside average single-core CPU throughput, while multi-core metrics and uncached memory bandwidth remain constrained by the low core count. Architectural highlights include AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix extensions. With its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the D2s_v6 is engineered for lightweight web services, small microservices, and general entry-level business application hosting.
